hook1: Attal : stop à la vie à crédit ?
description:
« La France doit arrêter de vivre à crédit » : la lettre de Gabriel Attal aux Français ✉️🐱 Pour 🐱 ou contre ❌ ? Un émoji suffit 👇
#actu #politique #dette #attal #presidentielle2027

segments.text: La France doit arrêter de vivre à crédit.
segments.bg: a warm blurred French village street with soft sunlight, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: extreme close-up of its face speaking straight to the camera, mouth open mid-sentence, eyes wide, one paw raised toward the camera, background softly blurred

segments.text: C'est la lettre de Gabriel Attal aux Français.
segments.bg: a cozy kitchen table at dusk with a warm lamp and a stack of envelopes, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: reading a letter with round glasses perched on its nose, then shaking its head slowly

segments.text: Il écrit aux électeurs pour alerter sur la dette.
segments.bg: a grand stone post office hall with tall windows and a row of wooden counters, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: carrying a tall stack of letters toward a counter, wobbling under the weight

segments.text: La dette revient dans le débat présidentiel, selon Les Echos.
segments.bg: a grand library with tall wooden shelves and a big window, golden light, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: stacking shiny coins into a wobbling tower, carefully, one by one

segments.text: Mandarine, elle, vit à crédit de croquettes.
segments.bg: a cozy café corner with a wooden table and a small bowl of kibble, warm light, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: nibbling from a small bowl and then holding up an empty spoon with a guilty look

segments.text: Tu es pour ? Mets un chat. Contre ? Mets une croix.
segments.bg: a stage with a warm spotlight and a red velvet curtain, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: standing on the stage with both paws open, looking straight at the camera as if asking a question

gstyle: reporter posée et calme, voix claire, débit normal, pas pressée, ton pince-sans-rire
